title: Cardiac Arrhythmias as a Prehospital Tracer Diagnosis, a Retrospective Cohort Analysis
summary: Cardiac arrhythmias of varying severity account for nearly a quarter of all emergency medical interventions. At best, these can be an unpleasant experience for the patient. However, arrhythmias can also be life-threatening conditions that require immediate emergency medical intervention. The aim of this study is to describe the nature and frequency of these arrhythmias and to analyze the actions taken by emergency physicians.

interventions.name: All patients with cardiac arrhythmia treated by emergency physicians of the Department of Emergency Medicine at Ulm University Hospital between 01.01.2015 and 30.09.2023.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All patients with a suspected diagnosis of arrhythmia
Patients with documented abnormal ECG findings
Exclusion criteria:
Diseases without suspected arrhythmia
